quote: Let $R$ be the ramification divisor of $\pi$. The involution $\iota_{\mathrm{dP}}$ on $X$ descends to an involution $\tau_{\mathrm{dP}}$ on $Z$, and $W=Z / \tau_{\mathrm{dP}}$. Let $R_{Z}$ and $B_{W}$ be the ramification and branch divisors of $\rho$. Then $R=\psi^{*}\left(R_{Z}\right)$ and $R_{Z}=\frac{1}{2} \psi_{*}(R)$. Since $R=\frac{1}{2} \pi^{*}(B)$ is an ample divisor, $R_{Z}$ is ample as well. One has $\mathcal{O}\left(R_{Z}\right)=\mathcal{L}_{Z}^{\otimes 2} \in \operatorname{Pic} Z$.
